name: Brali Practical Knowledge Library
description: Evidence-aware practical knowledge library with stable identities, versioned static API surfaces, bounded retrieval and a local read-only MCP server.

distributions.name: Brali API manifest
distributions.description: Generated API and dataset manifest with release metadata and checksums.

distributions.name: Brali search index
distributions.description: Static bounded search distribution over public Brali knowledge.

distributions.name: Brali evidence metrics
distributions.description: Generated corpus and evidence-state metrics, review queue counts and Evidence Decision totals.

distributions.name: Brali retrieval benchmark
distributions.description: Deterministic retrieval evaluation with cases, recall@k, precision@k and pass results.

distributions.name: Brali agent locale manifest
distributions.description: Canonical-language and fallback routing declaration that separates published locales from multilingual retrieval evaluation.

distributions.name: Brali AI Search and Citation Profile
distributions.description: Machine-readable discoverability, citation, trust, measurement and guardrail profile.

distributions.name: Brali canonical citation index
distributions.description: Stable canonical answers, Brali-defined vocabulary, machine surfaces and citation guardrails for search and AI systems.

distributions.name: Brali Trust Center
distributions.description: Machine-readable evidence, provenance, integrity, correction, reuse and measurement boundaries.

distributions.name: Brali corrections ledger
distributions.description: Public ledger contract for material corrections without a perfect-history claim.

distributions.name: Brali Knowledge Graph
distributions.description: JSON-LD graph linking the site, publisher, API, ontology, evidence, trust and update surfaces.

distributions.name: Brali crawler access matrix
distributions.description: Declared robots access policy for named and wildcard crawlers, explicitly separated from observed crawling, indexing or citation.

distributions.name: Brali project claims registry
distributions.description: Bounded registry of verifiable project-level facts, separate from scientific and practical Evidence Decisions.

distributions.name: Brali agent surface observatory
distributions.description: Repository-backed inventory of canonical machine-readable discovery, retrieval, evidence, trust and attribution surfaces.

distributions.name: Brali press facts
distributions.description: Reusable factual product description, canonical sources, citation guidance and licensing boundaries.

indexes.name: Brali search index
indexes.description: Static retrieval index over Brali knowledge records.
